Sam: Quick poll — Saturday brunch: what should the team bring? React with one emoji to vote: 🥞 pancakes, 🥯 bagels, 🥗 salad, 🍕 pizza. I’ll tally Friday 5pm.
Nina: Bagels? yes please :bagel:
Omar: Pancakes for the win. can we get gluten-free options?
Linda: Salad for me (trying to be good) :salad:
Jas: Pizza leftover champ :pizza: 
brunch-bot: Poll created — options: 🥞 / 🥯 / 🥗 / 🍕 — voting open until 2024-07-14 17:00 PT
Sam: Also — if bagels win, do we want schmear from Blue Jar or plain? Reply with 'blue' or 'plain'.
Nina: blue
Omar: plain + everything bagel
Linda: blue
Jas: whatever has cream cheese :thumbsup:
Sam: Cool. @brunch-bot can you message the ordering channel when voting ends?
brunch-bot: Sure — will post order thread and reminder 30m before pickup.
Sam: Results (final tally): 🥯 3, 🥞 1, 🥗 1, 🍕 1 — Bagels win. Ordering Blue Jar everything bagels (plus one GF pack). Pickup at Meeting Room A, 11:30 Saturday. Thanks all :tada:
